item.title: Consider Private Clouds & Universal Servers: a low effort open letter to Nostr
item.description: There’s not really much out there in terms of a ‘universal server’ that could meet the needs of self hosted apps, niche vibe coded projects, and general personal cloud type applications. I feel like Nostr might be able to fill this sort of niche - in some cases as it is now, and in others, likely with a new NIP or slightly different use of something already present like Blossom. But I lack the brain cells to make it happen, so I figured I’d yap about it on the internet instead, in the event my ideas might inspire someone else.
